newsitem.title: USA: Centex to buy 80 pct Cavco for about $75 mln.
newsitem.headline: Centex to buy 80 pct Cavco for about $75 mln.

text.p: Centex Corp said Thursday it has definitively agreed to acquire about 80 percent of Cavco Industries Inc's outstanding common stock for $26.75 per share.
The deal's estimated value is about $75 million based on 3.56 million Cavco shares outstanding, Centex said.
After the merger, Cavco founder Al Ghelfi and his affiliates will own the remaining Cavco shares, both companies said.
The deal, which remains subject to Cavco shareholder approval, is expected to close at the end of the 1997 first quarter, Centex said.
Cavco shares were up 1-7/8 at 25-1/2 Thursday morning. Centex shares were unchanged at 35-3/4.
Centex, a Dallas-based home builder and home mortgage originator, said acquiring the Arizona maker of manufactured homes gives it a strategic base to expand into the manufactured housing industry.

"As part of its manufactured housing efforts, Centex also intends to pursue both the development of real estate communities utilizing manufactured homes and the financing of manufactured homes," the company said in a release.
